The '''Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge''' was hosted in [[44 ABY]] by [[Booster Terrik]] on the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]''. The invitations were passed out by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to 100 of the most influential [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], as part of a plot to help the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] launch their [[StealthX]]s safely. As soon as the politicians were aboard the ''Errant Venture'', Terrik had their security teams incapacitated by [[coma gas]], and then he opened fire on orbital mirrors over Coruscant to distract the [[Sixth Fleet|Galactic Alliance Sixth Fleet]]&mdash;the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] could not return fire with the politicians on board, and the distraction allowed the StealthXs to launch successfully. The tournament continued as the ''Errant Venture'' traveled to [[Pydyr]] with the StealthXs, where the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] helped [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|fight off]] the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]]. By that time, the tournament was down to its final table, with [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] the favorite to win.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Then you do plan to launch the StealthXz? When?''"<br />"''When we can do so without fighting our way off Coruscant.|[[Saba Sebatyne]] and Kenth Hamner|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] began to fall prey to a [[Force psychosis]], causing strained relations between the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance government]]. Meanwhile, [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], encountered a new [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order wanted to send a wing of [[StealthX]]s to assist the Skywalkers, but were unable to due to first a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|raid]] on the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]],<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> and later a [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|siege]] of the Temple.<ref name="Vortex" />

When the siege was lifted in [[44 ABY]], the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] wanted to launch the StealthXs as quickly as possible, but interim Grand Master [[Kenth Hamner]] wanted the Jedi to wait&mdash;he had secretly made a deal with Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] to wait to launch the StealthXs until Bwua'tu gave his word, in order to ensure the cooperation of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Alliance Navy]] with the Jedi strike team. However, an [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|assassination attempt]] on Bwua'tu left him in a coma, unable to help, and when the rest of the Council learned of Hamner's actions, they grew furious and relieved him of his duty, determined to launch the StealthXs.<ref name="Vortex" />

Meanwhile, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] had returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with news of the Sith Tribe building a [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|war fleet]], and the Jedi decided that they needed to launch their StealthXs as soon as possible; although they acknowledged that, with the [[Sixth Fleet|Galactic Alliance Sixth Fleet]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], they would need to distract the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in order to launch safely. Calrissian thus passed out invitations to the first ever [[Tendrando Arms]] Celebrity [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] Charity Challenge, a sabacc charity event to be held for one hundred of the most influential [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] on Coruscant&mdash;including [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Fost Bramsin]] and [[Haydnat Treen]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]], and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]]. The entrance fee for the tournament was 1,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and the top prize was 50,000,000 credits.<ref name="Vortex" />

==The tournament==
{{Quote|One bit of good news. It looks like Wynn Dorvan may be considering early retirement.''"<br />[Simultaneously] "Retirement''?''"<br />"''That's right. He made the final table, and he's the hands-down favorite to win the first Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge.|Lando Calrissian, and Luke and Ben Skywalker|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
[[File:BoosterTerrik.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Booster Terrik, the tournament's host]]
The Jedi coordinated carefully with [[Booster Terrik]], who agreed to hold the tournament in his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]''. Treen was running late to the event, but Galactic Alliance [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] had heard about the tournament and showed interest, and as they were pressed for time, Terrik agreed to give him her chair. As the Jedi prepared to launch their StealthX wing, Terrik saw that the politicians' security teams were incapacitated by [[coma gas]], and the ''Errant Venture'' began to open fire on some of Coruscant's [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|Orbital Mirrors]]. The Galactic Alliance could not strike back with one hundred important government figures aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], and Terrik suggested that Dorvan&mdash;who was still on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], send a message to [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], explaining the situation to her. He was reluctant, claiming that she did not negotiate for hostages, but eventually complied. Although Hamner [[Skirmish in the Operations Hangar|attempted]] to prevent it, the StealthXs successfully launched and, thanks to the sabacc tournament, safely left Coruscant in the company of the ''Errant Venture''.<ref name="Vortex" />

Despite the fact that Dorvan sat down to the table ten minutes late, he was successful in the tournament. As the ''Errant Venture'' traveled with the StealthXs to meet the Skywalkers on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]], the three-day tournament reached its final table. By the time of their arrival at Pydyr, Dorvan was the favorite to win the tournament and he won.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> The strike team also arrived in time to help [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|rescue]] the Skywalkers from the Sith.<ref name="Vortex" />
